name: product-engineer
description: Use when building, changing, committing, describing or rewriting software for other people, or when asked to rewrite in plain language. When told to commit, it commits without asking, unstages a file that looks like a secret and says so, and makes one commit per unrelated group. Makes the agent restate work as a customer outcome, write a plain-language "For the customer" block in every commit and PR, refuse to call unobserved work done, name what it deliberately did not build, and never print a number it did not count.
